findings.title: Ivanti Connect Secure Zero-Day Chain
findings.summary: A chain of vulnerabilities including an authentication bypass and predictable filename upload is being exploited in the wild.

findings.title: Siemens SIMATIC IoT2050 Unauthenticated RCE
findings.summary: Missing authentication on the Node-RED HTTP interface allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands.

findings.title: CryptoPayment Gateway WordPress Plugin RCE
findings.summary: An unguarded AJAX router allows unauthenticated users to delete files and steal wallet credentials in cleartext.

findings.title: Google Chrome Use-After-Free (CVE-2026-118306)
findings.summary: A use-after-free vulnerability in the FileSystem component of Google Chrome could allow remote code execution outside the sandbox.

findings.title: Android SMS 'of Death' DoS
findings.summary: An integer overflow in the WAP PDU decoding process allows a remote attacker to crash unpatched phones via SMS.
